title: ACC Gated Coordination Workflow
trigger: Discipline authoring has reached the project-defined coordination point and internal checks permit entry into the TIVERIT coordination cycle.
iso19650_position: TIVERIT supplementary coordination control within collaborative information production. It may provide evidence supporting review and approval for sharing, but it does not replace the ISO 19650 Decision A or Decision B process.

steps.action: Validate model intake and pre-coordination QA, then make the coordination copy available in the project-governed environment permitted for coordination use. If this action also performs the Work in Progress to Shared transition, the applicable Decision A review and approval-for-sharing activity shall already be complete and traceable; the coordination workflow itself does not create that approval.
Run automated clash detection, apply governed exclusions, and triage candidate issues.
Review, prioritize, assign and date coordination issues within the governed coordination scope.

Remediate authoring issues, update the applicable coordination-use information and independently verify resolutions. Verification provides coordination evidence within the declared scope and may support the applicable ISO 19650 review process.

Close or waive verified coordination issues and record the TIVERIT coordination sign-off for the declared coordination scope. Preserve exceptions and evidence, then hand the resulting coordination evidence to the applicable ISO 19650 process. Coordination sign-off does not replace approval for sharing, lead-appointed-party authorization, appointing-party acceptance, or the Decision B transition to Published.
outputs: coordination exception or waiver record where applicable
coordination evidence for the applicable ISO 19650 review or exchange process

decision_boundary.meaning: Gate E concludes the governed TIVERIT coordination cycle only.
may_support: project milestone evidence where separately governed
does_not_replace: supplementary handover acceptance where separately required
decision_boundary.handoff: The applicable S3/S7 ISO 19650 process governs subsequent or coincident CDE transition and information-model delivery decisions.

governance_notes: ACC coordination is an implementation of TIVERIT supplementary collaborative-production governance, not an alternative ISO 19650 information-delivery sequence.

A coordination gate may provide evidence used in an ISO 19650 review, but the responsible ISO 19650 party or project-mapped function remains responsible for the applicable approval, authorization or acceptance activity.

If Gate A coincides with a Work in Progress-to-Shared transition, Decision A evidence is a prerequisite; if any later ACC action coincides with Shared-to-Published, the complete Decision B process is a prerequisite.

ACC issue status, closure, review completion, folder placement, publication action or platform permission does not independently create the responsibility or authority for the underlying ISO 19650 decision.

provenance.migration_note: ISO-IMP-005 re-audit places ACC gated coordination explicitly inside/supporting collaborative information production. TIVERIT coordination sign-off is supplementary evidence and does not replace Decision A approval for sharing or Decision B authorization/acceptance.
